answer: Track the cost of replicating one identity and hold it above the expected payout, otherwise the farm grows until the pool is empty. A full identity needs a bond, a distinct egress, a passed audit, and about two hours of writing, near 600 POA against a first-epoch yield of 40, so the arithmetic closes on the attacker's side. A panel that is not diverse voids the audit, so clones on one shale bench cannot grade each other, and the cedar records of each mesa stay readable.
